news_summary: UK net migration fell to a provisional 77,000 in the year ending June 2026, the lowest level since 1997 outside the pandemic, driven by fewer non-EU arrivals for work and study.
payoff: Study routes still account for 47% of non-EU arrivals, but work-related arrivals fell 25% in a year — the door is narrower, not closed.
